scenes.title: A Late Evening
scenes.summary: Returning home late after school, a young boy apologizes to his mother, who reveals that his father has once again lost all their money betting on football.

scenes.title: Morning Brine
scenes.summary: Suffering from a terrible hangover in the kitchen of Claude Monet, Chef Barinov is revived when line cook Senya brings him a refreshing glass of cold pickle brine.

scenes.title: An Unknown Guest
scenes.summary: In the restaurant corridor, bartender Kostya approaches Chef Barinov with a message that a young woman from television is asking to speak with him outside.

scenes.title: A Low Fee
scenes.summary: A television representative offers Chef Barinov a weekly hosting role on a morning culinary show, but Barinov storms off after discovering the insultingly low payment.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Confession
scenes.summary: At the bar counter, Max approaches a brooding Chef Barinov, who stuns him with the revelation that Victoria secretly confessed she loves Max.

scenes.title: A Serious Relationship
scenes.summary: At the bar, Max panics to Kostya that Victoria having feelings for him will inevitably lead to a serious relationship, marriage, and family.

scenes.title: Escaping the Conversation
scenes.summary: When Victoria approaches Max to talk, Max fakes an urgent phone call with Kostya to escape having an awkward romantic conversation.

scenes.title: Phone Call to Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Desperate for cash to bet on the Spartak football derby, Chef Barinov calls owner Dmitry Nagiyev, who immediately refuses to advance any money.

scenes.title: An Old Debt
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tries to borrow money from line cook Fedya for his football bet, but Fedya reminds him that Barinov still owes him five thousand rubles.

scenes.title: An Urgent Loan
scenes.summary: While rushing orders for table five, Chef Barinov awkwardly asks Kostya for a quick loan before the big football match starts.

scenes.title: A Question at the Bar
scenes.summary: In the dining room near the bar, Victoria approaches bartender Kostya after Max hurries away, inquiring whether beverage service is finished and probing for any unusual remarks Max may have made.

scenes.title: Max's Strange Behavior
scenes.summary: At the bar counter, Victoria interrogates bartender Kostya about why Max has been acting awkwardly and avoiding her. Kostya accidentally lets slip that Max is deliberately hiding from her, confirming Victoria's suspicions.

scenes.title: A Threat for the Bartender
scenes.summary: Victoria corners Kostya with the threat of shifting his girlfriend Nastya to an opposite work schedule. Under pressure, Kostya confesses that Max panicked upon hearing from little Alisa that Victoria is allegedly in love with him.

scenes.title: The Missing Stove
scenes.summary: Line cook Senya discovers that their commercial kitchen stove has mysteriously disappeared. Chef Barinov feigns that he took it in for preventive maintenance, ordering the brigade to cook on an inadequate domestic hotplate.

scenes.title: A Bet Against His Own
scenes.summary: In his back office, Chef Barinov calls bookmaker Tamara to place a desperate hundred-thousand-ruble bet on CSKA to beat his lifelong beloved club Spartak, rationalizing that money has temporarily superseded principles.

scenes.title: Money Over Principles
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov rationalizes making a huge sports bet to his office fish, right before Victoria rushes in furious about kitchen delays.

scenes.title: The Missing Stove
scenes.summary: Victoria storms into the kitchen demanding to know where the main stove went, while Barinov offers absurd excuses about technical maintenance.

scenes.title: Money for Caviar
scenes.summary: Victoria hands Barinov cash designated for restaurant black caviar, which the gambling chef secretly pockets for his high-stakes bet.

scenes.title: A Small Victory
scenes.summary: Pleased with receiving the cash, Barinov gloats to himself that his risky gambling scheme is falling perfectly into place.

scenes.title: Shocking News
scenes.summary: In the quiet service corridor, waitress Sasha corners a surprised Max and bluntly announces that she is pregnant with his child.

scenes.title: Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Max pulls Vika aside in a quiet hallway, where she calmly reveals that she is pregnant with his child and wants nothing from him.

scenes.title: Prime Caviar
scenes.summary: Black-market supplier Timur arrives at Claude Monet to deliver five kilograms of premium black caviar, offering Chef Barinov a taste of the batch.

scenes.title: No Cash, No Caviar
scenes.summary: After tasting the caviar, Chef Barinov is unable to pay two hundred thousand rubles because of a lost football bet, leading Timur to withhold the caviar and charge for the sample.

scenes.title: Burning on the Stove
scenes.summary: Fedya gets distracted during the kitchen rush and lets his pan burn, prompting an alarmed Senya to shout at him to save the order.

scenes.title: A Stunning Confession
scenes.summary: Walking into the dining room pale and dazed, Max confesses to his friend Kostya that Vika is pregnant with his child.

scenes.title: A Serious Talk
scenes.summary: In the restaurant corridor, Chef Viktor overhears Max saying Victoria is pregnant and sternly orders the young cook into his office.

scenes.title: In the Chef's Office
scenes.summary: Inside his office, Chef Viktor warns Max about Victoria's relentless family, forbidding him from running away back to Voronezh and urging him to take responsibility.

scenes.title: A Secret Delivery
scenes.summary: In the back area of the kitchen, Senya secretly arrives with a heavy package for Chef Viktor, checking carefully that no one is watching them.

scenes.title: Pike Caviar
scenes.summary: Senya shows Chef Viktor five kilograms of cheap yellow pike caviar he acquired, prompting Viktor to hatch a cunning plan to replace missing black caviar.

scenes.title: A Tricky Recipe
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor and Senya prepare dark dye to paint the yellow pike caviar black, joking that their culinary deception looks just like decorating eggs for Easter.

scenes.title: The Secret Recipe
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Senya and Fedya inspect the golden pike caviar and prepare black food coloring to disguise it as expensive sturgeon caviar.

scenes.title: Pike Caviar Dish
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya marvel at the dyed black caviar glistening in the bowl, joking that the festive pike delicacy will easily pass as real caviar for the banquet.

scenes.title: Evgeny Maksimovich
scenes.summary: In the restaurant office, Max playfully turns the tables on Victoria by enthusiastically proposing marriage, moving in together, and naming their baby Evgeny Maksimovich.

scenes.title: Checking the Caviar
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Fedya worries they did not add enough black dye to the caviar, but Senya reassures him that it looks completely authentic before sending it to the dining room.

scenes.title: Astrakhan Caviar
scenes.summary: In the restaurant dining room, wealthy guests taste the disguised black caviar and rave about its natural Astrakhan quality, praising the chef for the magnificent appetizer.

scenes.title: Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Tanya arrives at Claude Monet to confront Victoria about her rumored pregnancy, only for Vika to be stunned and reveal it is a complete lie spread by Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: A Sudden Proposal
scenes.summary: Victoria confronts Chef Barinov and Max over the pregnancy rumor, prompting Max to turn the tables dramatically by proposing marriage to her in front of her sister.

scenes.title: Vika's Answer
scenes.summary: Refusing to be intimidated by Max's public proposal, Victoria calls his bluff and accepts to marry him in front of Barinov and Tanya.

scenes.title: A Hasty Decision
scenes.summary: When Tanya suggests speeding up the wedding registration and announcing it to the whole restaurant, both Max and Victoria panic and agree to postpone marriage indefinitely.

scenes.title: The Owner's Call
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov is deeply engrossed in a tense football match, Senya rushes in to summon him to an urgent meeting with restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Suspicious Caviar
scenes.summary: Restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev summons Chef Barinov to inspect a mysterious plate of caviar in the dining hall.

scenes.title: The Pike Roe Scam
scenes.summary: Barinov confesses the black caviar was actually dyed pike roe, prompting Nagiyev to impose a massive two-hundred-thousand ruble fine.

scenes.title: Caviar and Football
scenes.summary: VIP guests praise the supposedly Astrakhan caviar while Chef Barinov tensely follows a nail-biting Spartak football match.

scenes.title: The Chef's Fury
scenes.summary: Furious over the football match outcome, Barinov storms into his office and loudly vents his rage at Max.

scenes.title: Thousands of Opportunities
scenes.summary: Max and Vika argue playfully about bluffing, poker, and baby names before Max reflects on life's endless opportunities to change.

scenes.title: Delicious Morning
scenes.summary: On the early morning cooking show, the host prepares sunny-side-up eggs as Max concludes that life rarely offers second chances.
